text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the operating times of the existing short-term parking area on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, west of Avenue Road, adjacent to Allenby Public School. The proposed parking amendments will address the concerns of the administration of the school and on-site daycare, as well as parents, regarding on-street pick-up and drop-off operating hours. Additionally, the changes will address the concerns of residents on this street by improving the two-way flow of traffic on St. Clements Avenue during the weekday morning peak period. North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 37 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 114 metres west of Avenue Road, to be in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Prohibited parking from 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 37 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 114 metres west of Avenue Road. 3. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St. Clements Avenue, between a point 120 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 170 metres west of Avenue Road.
